findings.summary: Benchmark claims in the PR body use the wrong baseline (ignore-0.4.33 tag instead of the PR base), so they include #3555/#3556 savings, and omit affinity, LTO config, run count, benchmark names and absolute times that the bench README requires; the slower control also puts the walk gains inside the noise floor.
Looped test asserts carry no message naming which ignore file failed; add the name as the assert message.

why: The one blocking finding is a confirmed claim in the PR body (wrong baseline, missing bench-README details) that the reviewer says must be redone before merge, though maintainers merged without changes. The other finding is a test-message nit.
